testcase.name: Scenario: Move and reopens the ribbon customization dialog: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1728:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Move and reopens the ribbon customization dialog ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization is open without pending edits ✔ When the user drags the dialog title bar to another visible position ✔ Then the dialog moves to the new position ✔ And its Ribbon tab, command lists and target selector remain visible ✔ When the user closes customization and reopens it from Tools in the same session ✔ Then the dialog reopens at the moved position ✔ And its Ribbon tab and Part Tools target are displayed
